title: Multifidelity Formulations for Triangular Transport
summary: We develop multifidelity methods for constructing triangular transport maps from samples, when high-fidelity data are scarce but lower-fidelity data are more abundant. Using this set of multifidelity data, we approximate a triangular transport map that bijectively maps between a tractable reference density and the high-fidelity target distribution.
